name: Naftuhim
title: Peoples descended from Mizraim
summary: Naftuhim was one of the peoples descended from Mizraim (Egypt) in the table of nations. The name refers to an Egyptian people, possibly from the Nile Delta.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the table of nations
keyEvents.description: Naftuhim is listed among Mizraim's descendants in the genealogy of Ham.
